rows.explainer:
Summary result for the impact of water chlorination interventions on diarrhea cases from Clasen et al. 2015, a recent Cochrane review. Clasen et al. 2015, Summary of findings table 1, Diarrhoea episodes https://www.cochranelibrary.com/cdsr/doi/10.1002/14651858.CD004794.pub3/full. The studies included are point-of-use chlorination.
A recent RCT of point-of-collection chlorination finds the same effect size: "Children in the treatment group had less WHO-defined diarrhoea than did children in the control group (control 216 [10·0%] of 2154; treatment 156 [7·5%] of 2073; prevalence ratio 0·77, 95% CI 0·65–0·91)" Pickering et al. 2019, https://www.thelancet.com/journals/langlo/article/PIIS2214-109X(19)30315-8/fulltext.

rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
